instruction: Withdraw: barcrawl Card, Coins, Enchanted Scroll, Enchanted Quill (4 Inventory Slots)
Head into the Port Sarim Bar for the Barcrawl (Bartender_(Rusty_Anchor_Inn))
Head to Veos and travel to Port Piscarilius. You will receive your X Marks the Spot Lamp, use on Herblore
OPTIONAL: Travel to Lands end if you haven't got your 100 Soda Ash/Sand
Head North to the Piscarillius General Store, talk to Leenz(3,2)
Head South then Directly East along the pier to reach the Food Store; Buy Raw Sea Bass, Swordfish, 3x Cod & 15 Sardines while here for your Kitten
Head west to the Minecart and travel to Lovakengj. Bank the fish
Head East and slightly North to the General Store, talk to Munty (4,2)
Buy an inventory of Balls of Wool & bank them West
Head directly North on the path to Arceuus general Store and talk to Regath (4,2) [Client of Kourend]
Walk to the Hosidius General Store, talk to Horace (3,2)
Bank West side of the Square and deposit everything
Steal from the Fruit stall [Kourend Easy Diary]

Head East & thieve from the Hosidius fruit stall until 34512 Thieving Experience. Bank 5x Redberries, all Golovanova's + Strange fruit and 1x Jangerberries [Fairytale Part I, possible item for Malignius Mortifer]. Run between both stalls as it is faster. Once you are 0 energy, recharge at 1 stall.
